sos.official_disclaimer: This app assists pushkaralu volunteers and command control. It supplements and NEVER replaces official emergency 112.
sos.title: Emergency SOS
sos.subtitle: Select emergency category. Countdown will trigger alert.
sos.gps_privacy_notice: Your location is acquired only when you trigger an emergency SOS alert, used exclusively to dispatch help.

location.zone_placeholder: Enter Zone Code or Scan QR (e.g. ZONE-KOTI-A)

alerts.helpline_disclaimer: Pushkaralu 24x7 Helpline: 112 / 108. For life-threatening emergencies, alert the nearest police helpdesk immediately.

empty.no_reports: No reports submitted yet from this device.
empty.report_first: Report an issue if you encounter problems at any ghat.

seva.title: Virtual Seva & Events
seva.disclaimer: Ritual and Harathi timings are subject to change suddenly due to crowd safety protocols and river water levels. All streams are officially sanctioned by the District Administration.

transport.title: Transport & Shuttles
transport.disclaimer: Notice: During Godavari Pushkaralu, bus routes, rail platforms, and green corridors are dynamically managed by district traffic authorities. Conditions and timings can change suddenly.

landing.tagline: One unified access point for pilgrims
landing.disclaimer: Official data is labelled. Ghat conditions, water levels, and crowd movement can change dynamically during Pushkaralu.

register.error_consent_required: Please accept the privacy policy to proceed.
